name: Embedded, Adaptive Volume Tree Structure
aliases: Lat/lon quadtree with volume tree leaves
definition: A hierarchical structure for organizing multiresolution splats of 3D non-uniform data, designed to support different data types and spatial magnitudes. It consists of a top-level forest of quadtrees covering the domain (e.g., Earth), mid-level volume trees aligned with quadtree nodes, and bottom-level leaf nodes containing non-uniform data points.
summary: This hybrid structure uses a lat/lon quadtree for global overviews and switches to an embedded volume tree for local details, optimizing earth-based atmospheric rendering by adapting to spatial magnitude differences.
